description: Per transaction and trader type, count the distinct transactions.

c.request: Take transactions that have advanced behaviour analysis (`advancedbehavior.translink` = `transactionrecord.transreg`) and link them to their trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), dropping anything unmatched. For each transaction and trader type, find how many there are and what share of the overall total that is. Then, for each trader type, give the average count and the average share, unrounded. Per transaction and trader type, count the distinct transactions.
c.sql: WITH transaction_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr INNER JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), transaction_shares AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM transaction_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share FROM transaction_shares GROUP BY tradekind;

b.request: For each transaction with a matching advanced behaviour analysis record and trader, count distinct transactions by transaction and trader type, calculate each count’s share of the overall distinct transaction total, then report the unrounded average count and average share for each trader type
b.sql: WITH transaction_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), overall_total AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) AS total_transactions FROM transaction_counts) SELECT tc.tradekind, AVG(tc.transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count, AVG(tc.transaction_count::numeric / ot.total_transactions) AS average_share FROM transaction_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN overall_total AS ot GROUP BY tc.tradekind ORDER BY tc.tradekind;

a.request: Link each advanced behaviour record (`advancedbehavior`) to its transaction (`translink` = `transactionrecord.transreg`) and then to that transaction's trader (`trdref` = `trader.tradereg`), dropping anything without a match. For each pair of transaction and trader type (`tradekind`), count the distinct transactions (`transreg`) and work out that count's share of the total count across all pairs. Then, for each trader type, give the trader type, the average count per pair and the average share per pair, unrounded.
a.sql: WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, td.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS td ON tr.trdref = td.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, td.tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS transaction_share FROM pair_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count_per_pair, AVG(transaction_share) AS average_share_per_pair FROM pair_shares GROUP BY tradekind

d.request: Join transactions with advanced behaviour analysis (`advancedbehavior.translink = transactionrecord.transreg`) to their traders (`trdref = tradereg`), excluding unmatched records. For each transaction and trader type, count the distinct transactions and calculate their share of the overall total. Then, for each trader type, calculate the unrounded average count and average share.
d.sql: WITH transaction_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), transaction_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS transaction_share FROM transaction_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) AS average_count, AVG(transaction_share) AS average_share FROM transaction_shares GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind;
